flags: The cache confirms byway status for Routes 311 and 43 but does not supply the corridor designation date, full designated limits, or a designating-body description specific to all four routes. Route 159 coverage is limited to its junction with 311.

The strip map has separate mileage sequences. Moments follow Sweet Chalybeate toward Hanging Rock, with an explicit Route 42 out-and-back at New Castle; this is a network, not a single end-to-end road.
Meadow Creek Falls has only route-description evidence, so its moment is shorter; no safe stopping place, pedestrian access or waterfall view is established.
McAfee Knob cache gives conflicting hiking distances (4, 4.4 and 4.7 miles) and mixes old crossing instructions with a late-2024 bridge update. Exact distance and access logistics omitted.
Paint Bank name and Civil War material omitted: no community or primary historical source is cached to check these consequential accounts. Mill county chronology conflicts with the Craig County page.

The December 20, 1990 designation date in material is not in the cached list. All current drive claims are supported; McAfee’s exact four-mile hike is omitted because the same cache disagrees, and the most-photographed claim has no named authority.
